lines.4: 「Women are terrifying. How does what they say change this much?」
lines.5: 「And yet, is molding her into your ideal not a man's true calling?」
lines.7: 「We've been talking about classy stuff a lot lately, huh?」
lines.8: 「All right, let's debate current Middle Eastern affairs.」
lines.9: 「Because of France's recent immigration policy, there have been riots in Paris...」
lines.10: 「I'd love to know what part of that counts as the Middle East to you.」
lines.11: Kinu self-destructed trying to show off knowledge she'd only just picked up.
lines.12: In the end, it became another ordinary night.
